reviewers.role: Prüferin (lizenzierte telc-B1-Prüferin): exam fidelity, rubric application, task clarity
Kursleiterin DaF/DaZ, Niveau B1.1: naturalness, level, didactics, scene plausibility

method: We read every German string again: start and Folge; LS1 Text A with its items, pool, reserve and micro-output; LS2 dialogue, items, structured input, pool, reserve, micro-output and Aussprache; the LS3 rule table, pool and reserve; the LS4 texts t1-t6, the tb1.sb1 and tb1.hv3 blocks and their strategy cards; the LS5 and LS6 Aufgaben; the LS7/LS8 end lines; check, proof items, portrait, Redemittel, story, Fokus and facts. We solved every item blind from promptDe plus its options, tiles or audio line, and compared the result with answer and accepted[]. Where a second answer looked defensible, we ran it through the real checker (src/lib/course-v2/checkItem.js). We recorded every key position. We checked the exam blocks and Aufgaben against content/course-v2/registries/lanes/tb1.json (sb1, hv3, sa, m2). We traced the speaking and writing tasks through the runtime: SpeakingTaskView.jsx, WritingTaskView.jsx, speakingAI.mjs normalizeSpeakingTask and buildCoursePartnerPrompt, and compiler.mjs. We checked grammar against grammar-spine.json and detectors.json, the lexicon against b1.1/lexicon.json and level-profiles.json, the can-dos against registries/cando/b1.json, the cast against casts/b1.json, casts/series.json and casts/a1.json, and the rule cards against b1.1/rule-cards.json. Each of the 19 r1 findings was re-verified. For the four r1 class rules we rebuilt the r1 defects in a scratch copy of the unit (outside the repo) and ran the validator on it. Validator: node scripts/course-v2/validate.mjs content/course-v2/b1.1/units/u04.json returned OK: 39 rules, 33 pass, 0 fail, 2 warn (LEX-02: 41 ratchet; GRM-04: 14 advisory), 4 skipped (level scope), 0 blocker. node scripts/course-v2/check.mjs on the unit returned 0 errors.
verdict: Not exitable in round 2, but close on the unit side. 15 of the 19 r1 findings are fixed in the unit, including both blockers. F04, F05 and F15 are partly fixed, and F17 needed no unit change. Betreff is allocated. The keys are balanced (11/10/11; sb1 3/3/2). The complaint call is now performed in the planning round. The rule table teaches obwohl and trotzdem correctly, and the story timeline holds. Every key is correct and the four Teile match tb1.json. Open: 0 blocker, 5 major, 7 minor. Majors: (F01) none of the four class rules proposed in r1 exists, and a scratch copy with the r1 defects passes the validator; (F02) the tb1.m2 runtime shows the learner the partner's sheet, never gives the AI that sheet, and does not brief the planning round or the switch to the Kundenservice, which the reklamieren proof now depends on; (F03) the q02 explanation and rc.obwohl still misplace the Gegengrund, a residual of r1 F04; (F04) Beweis and zurückerstattet are rejected; (F05) the c06 dictation rejects „2 E-Mails“, the same class as a2.2-u04.r2 F07. F01 and the class halves of F02 and F05 need the rule-smith and the runtime owners, not the unit author. The unit-side fixes for F02-F05 are small.

findings.quote: stimulus.items[1]: „Blatt der Partnerin – Monika, 58, Bibliothekarin: „Ich kaufe lieber im Geschäft …““ · normalizeSpeakingTask returns no stimulus · discuss brief: „Vertritt freundlich die Gegenposition … Bitte am Ende um eine kurze Zusammenfassung.“ · global rules: „Verlasse deine Rolle nicht.“, „verwendest keine Rollenbezeichnungen“ · modelTurns[11]: „Gut, jetzt spiele ich den Kundenservice.“
findings.problem: Three runtime facts break this unit's tb1.m2 format and endanger the reklamieren call that fixed r1 F03. First, SpeakingTaskView prints every stimulus item under „Material“, so the learner reads Monika's sheet before the partner reports it. tb1.json says the learner sees the partner's opinion only when she reports it, and in the exam A and B hold different sheets. Second, normalizeSpeakingTask drops stimulus, so the AI partner never receives Monika's quote. It must invent her opinion, age and job from „berichtet die Meinung von Monika“, and that version can contradict the sheet on the learner's screen. Third, the discuss brief never mentions planningRound (only plan-together does) and asks for a summary at the end. The global rules forbid leaving the role and using role labels. The switch to the Kundenservice is now the only place where cd.b1.reklamieren is performed, and it relies on personaDe alone, against those rules. Model turn 11 contains exactly the role label the brief forbids. Two smaller effects: support „examiner“ makes the UI say „Gesprächsleitung (KI)“, although this AI is a fellow candidate. And each quote renders inside a second pair of „…“, because the items already contain quotation marks.
findings.fix: Unit: keep only the learner's sheet in stimulus.items („Ihr Blatt – Thomas, 34, Krankenpfleger: Ich kaufe fast alles online, …“, with no inner quotation marks). Move Monika's full quote into aiRole.personaDe („Dein Blatt – Monika, 58, Bibliothekarin: …“). Also state the sequence there: „Nach der Diskussion planst du mit deinem Gegenüber den Anruf; dann bist du der Kundenservice (Sie) …“. Class (owners: speakingAI.mjs, SpeakingTaskView.jsx, SCHEMA §8 comment „tb1.m2 two quotes“): pass the partner side of the stimulus and planningRound into the brief for every mode; allow a role switch that the task declares; never render the partner's sheet; label a tb1.m2 partner with aiRole.name.
findings.proposedRule: EXM-04: for tb1.m2 (the partner's sheet is hidden), stimulus.items holds exactly one quote, the learner's, and the partner's quote must appear in aiRole.personaDe. Runtime test: buildCoursePartnerPrompt for b11-u04-s contains Monika's quote and the planning-round/role-switch instruction; SpeakingTaskView renders one quote for tb1.m2.

findings.quote: q02: „Man hat die Anleitung gelesen und erwartet: Das Gerät läuft. Es geht aber aus – ein Gegengrund, also Obwohl.“ · rc.obwohl: „Mit obwohl nennen Sie einen Gegengrund: Etwas passiert, aber man erwartet es nicht. … trotzdem bedeutet dasselbe, steht aber im Hauptsatz …“
findings.problem: r1 F04 is only partly fixed. The rule table, its header and the explanations of ls3-p04, c02, sb1-03 and s03 are corrected. The q02 explanation was missed: it calls „Es geht aber aus“ the Gegengrund. That clause is the unexpected result. The Gegengrund is „ich mache alles richtig“, and obwohl belongs to it. A learner who follows this explanation writes „Obwohl das Gerät ausgeht, mache ich alles richtig“. This is the error the unit exists to prevent, and the explanation appears right after the can-do proof of cd.b1.brief-formen-erkennen. The rule card has the same problem. Its gloss after the colon describes the unexpected event, not the Gegengrund. „trotzdem bedeutet dasselbe, steht aber im Hauptsatz“ also does not say that trotzdem stands in the other sentence, at the unexpected result. The unit's own s03 now says this correctly, and the card contradicts it on the same screen.
findings.fix: q02.explanation.de: „„Ich mache alles richtig“ ist der Gegengrund: Man erwartet dann, dass das Gerät läuft. obwohl steht beim Gegengrund, das Verb mache am Ende. Trotzdem passt nicht, denn danach kommt sofort das Verb.“ rc.obwohl (owner: b1.1 rule cards, then check GRM-05 again): „Mit obwohl nennen Sie einen Gegengrund: Er passt nicht zum Ergebnis im Hauptsatz. … trotzdem steht im anderen Satz, beim unerwarteten Ergebnis: auf Position 1 mit dem Verb direkt danach oder hinter dem Verb.“
